content:
Many X users have found their feeds to be quite random, and most replies come from strangers rather than followers. The platform says it has finally noticed this issue and is "adjusting" its algorithm to fix it...

The social platform formerly known as Twitter is increasingly resembling a mess. One of the biggest complaints is that our feeds are no longer made up of the accounts we follow, but are instead dominated by people that X thinks we should be reading.

Product lead Nikita Bier says they only recently realized they had not been prioritising mutual follow relationships, and the company is now rolling out a fix.

Whether this measure can truly solve one of X's biggest problems remains to be seen.
